Q: GitHub pages are not updating A:

At the bottom right of the github project page there is an Environments section as shown below:

Clicking github-pages with show the current status of the deployment.

After a new commit the workflow can take a while to complete and will display in Pending status.

Apparently, even after the status turns back to Active it can take some minutes for the actual changes to be seen live.

To see what exactly is happening click the Actions tab in the repo and look at the latest workflow pages-build-deployment - if must display a green checkmark ✅ or an orange progress - click the workflow for more details.

From project Settings > Pages at the top of the page you can also see the status and time of the last deployment, e.g. something like:

Last deployed by user2030 33 minutes ago.

Hovering over the minutes will show the full timestamp.

Q: Why is clip-path: inset() being ignored/overridden in my React component layout? A:

Your clip-path is being ignored because the value is invalid.

You have a typo here:

clip-path: inset(0px 0x 35px 0px);

The second value is 0x, which isn’t a valid CSS length. It should be:

clip-path: inset(0px 0px 35px 0px);

When a CSS value is invalid, the browser discards the entire declaration, which is why DevTools shows it crossed out.

If your goal is simply to hide the bottom of the blue circle, clip-path: inset(...) will work once corrected. If you need to keep the phone overflowing while clipping only the circle, consider wrapping just the .blue-circle in its own container with overflow: hidden, or apply the clipping to a dedicated parent instead of the entire banner.
